scripts.text:
[Rachel Guide]
Welcome to the capital of Arunafeltz, ^8B4513Rachel^000000 where the warm breath of the goddess Freya reaches.
If this is the first time for you to use the guide services, I suggest you ask many questions.
scripts.translation:
[拉赫向导]
欢迎来到阿鲁纳菲兹首都^8B4513拉赫^000000，这里沐浴着芙蕾雅女神的温暖气息。
第一次找向导的话，不妨多问问。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Guide]
When you click on the ^B9062F[location name]^000000, you'll receive the most advanced ^B9062FNavigation^000000 services!

You can rest your fatigue of the journey in the <NAVI>[Inn]<INFO>rachel,115,144,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>. The left building next to me is the Inn of Rachel.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:

还想了解其他地点吗？
